Maya (CSM): FYI flagged: NovaGrid renewal > high risk. Active API keys down ~60% in 10 days; champion A. Soto moved teams. Need triage.
Emily (AM): Is the dip route-specific?
Maya (CSM): Mostly /v1/convert ingestion; embeddings also down ~55%.
Raj (SE): Share query/telemetry and I9ll check cache/fallbacks.
Maya (CSM): SQL snapshot:
```sql
SELECT route, date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, count(*) AS calls
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id = 'novagrid' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```
Maya (CSM): Key days: 2026-03-10:1120, 2026-03-17:450, 2026-03-20:420.
ops-bot: Alert: quota usage below expected baseline (2 windows).
Ben (Solutions Eng): Any open tickets?
Maya (CSM): Two latency tickets ~3w ago, resolved after hotfix.
Emily (AM): Procurement asked for competitor POC last week. Could be switching.
Raj (SE): Doing a routing/cache check 15m.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Suggest offering a 2-week sandbox + enablement for their new ML lead. Historically helps.
Maya (CSM): Also propose a short QBR with ops/dev/procurement. Emily to schedule?
Emily (AM): Yes. Tentative Wed 10-11 PT.
Maya (CSM): Raj, can you draft a short diagnostics runbook?
Raj (SE): Draft: "Run `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` capture 10 p50/p95 latency samples and attach last 3 logs for /v1/convert."
Maya (CSM): Perfect. I'll DM NovaGrid with sandbox offer + runbook.
Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a 30-min workshop: batching/cache tips, examples.
Emily (AM): Marking CRM as 'advocate-exit' and adding pilot extension offer.
Maya (CSM): Actions: 1) Raj full telemetry check (ETA 30m) 2) Ben workshop (24h) 3) Emily schedule QBR & CRM update 4) Maya outreach.
Raj (SE): Quick check done: no model fallback, KV cache hit down 78% -> 12% (2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-20). Likely client cache invalidation.
Maya (CSM): Explains token cost spike. Calling them to confirm client change and push sandbox.
Emily (AM): If procurement pushes price, offer pilot + workshop and request a one-page POC spec with 3 success criteria.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all. Will update thread after call. :thumbsup:
